## General Information[edit]

Below is a list of over 80 verified power armor locations. The locations are listed by region. The regions are listed from least to most challenging.

Power Armor Chassis with pieces of armor can be found throughout Appalachia. A full set never spawns; there will usually be two or three of the six armor pieces. There are two types of spawn points; the first will spawn with Raider Power Armor, the second will spawn with T-45 (most common), T-60 (next most common), or T-51b (least common). 

The armor pieces will all be of the same type and level. The armor pieces at the next spawn at a given location could be for the same set or for a different level (and/or a different type for T-series armors). The Power Armor Chassis has a high chance of spawning with a Fusion Core. Some locations also have a Power Armor Station and/or a nearby extra Fusion Core. Power armor can be mixed and matched, there is no advantage to a matched set except for the carry bonus on quest related Excavator Power Armor.

Some spawn points are at named locations, some are not and are listed with the nearest named location. The power armor icon on the map images shows the actual power armor location or the entrance to the building, mine, cave, or tunnel if the location is inside since the map marker does not move once a player character enters one of those areas.

### Northern Forest[edit]

| Location | Type | Description | Image |

### Southwest Forest[edit]

| Location | Type | Description | Image | 
| Silva Homestead | T‑series | At the Power Armor Station in the large rounded metal building near a silo. It is south of Silva Homestead and north of Billings Homestead. | ![PowerArmor Silva Homestead.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/8/8c/PowerArmor_Silva_Homestead.webp/170px-PowerArmor_Silva_Homestead.webp) | 
| New River Gorge Bridge West | Raider | West end, behind a locked door that cannot be picked. The key is at Camden Park on the roller coaster. A Fusion Core can spawn in the closet just inside the entry door. | ![PowerArmor New River Gorge Bridge.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/c/c9/PowerArmor_New_River_Gorge_Bridge.webp/170px-PowerArmor_New_River_Gorge_Bridge.webp) | 
| Kanawha Nuka-Cola Plant | T‑series | Enter the loading dock, use the door on the left and it is in the large room at a Power Armor Station. A Fusion Core can spawn in a locked security cage through the door to the left of the power armor. | ![PowerArmor Kanawha Nuka-Cola plant.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/a/a8/PowerArmor_Kanawha_Nuka-Cola_plant.webp/170px-PowerArmor_Kanawha_Nuka-Cola_plant.webp) | 
| Poseidon Energy Plant WV-06 | T‑series | In the basement, in a locked security cage in the room labeled "workroom." The key to the room is found in the main office or the skill 2 lock can be picked. A Fusion Core can also spawn on the table. One route is to look for the single cooling tower on the left (south). Go in the door closest to the tower, follow signs for "Cooling Tower #3". Go through the cooling tower then follow the hallway to the door labeled "Main Plant". The Workroom is straight ahead. | ![PowerArmor Poseidon Energy Plant WV-06.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/b/b3/PowerArmor_Poseidon_Energy_Plant_WV-06.webp/170px-PowerArmor_Poseidon_Energy_Plant_WV-06.webp) | 
| Hornwright Industrial Headquarters | T‑series | In the sub-basement. Accessible during and after the side quest The Motherlode. When entering the sub-basement, the armor is straight ahead. | ![FO76 Location Hornwright Industrial Headquarters 07.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/f/f7/FO76_Location_Hornwright_Industrial_Headquarters_07.webp/170px-FO76_Location_Hornwright_Industrial_Headquarters_07.webp) | 
| Wade Airport North | T‑series | In the hanger immediately north of the control tower. | ![PowerArmor Wade Airport North.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/e5/PowerArmor_Wade_Airport_North.webp/170px-PowerArmor_Wade_Airport_North.webp) | 
| Wade Airport South | Raider | In a blue truck trailer at the south end of the runway with a skill 2 lock. There can also be a plasma mine under the trailer. Opening this lock while another player claims the workshop is no longer considered a crime. This was corrected in Fallout 76 patch 1.1.0.8. | ![PowerArmor Wade Airport South.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/7/7e/PowerArmor_Wade_Airport_South.webp/170px-PowerArmor_Wade_Airport_South.webp) |

### North Savage Divide[edit]

| Location | Type | Description | Image | 
| Converted Munitions Factory | T‑series | Behind a skill 1 locked door inside the building. The room is accessible from a catwalk that overlooks the workshop. Note that if the workshop is claimed by another player, picking this lock results in a bounty. | Location | Type | Description | Image |

| Wendigo Cave | Raider | To get the power armor, always go to the right (there is one small dead-end room on the right before finding the armor). There are two bodies on the ground. | ![PowerArmor Wendigo Cave.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/b/b2/PowerArmor_Wendigo_Cave.webp/170px-PowerArmor_Wendigo_Cave.webp) |

### East Ash Heap[edit]

The two routes have about the same number of scorched. | ![PowerArmor Big Bend Tunnel.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/9/92/PowerArmor_Big_Bend_Tunnel.webp/170px-PowerArmor_Big_Bend_Tunnel.webp) |

This is also the location for the side quest Miner Miracles which gives plans for the Excavator Power Armor. | ![PowerArmor Garrahan Mining HQ.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/9/9b/PowerArmor_Garrahan_Mining_HQ.webp/170px-PowerArmor_Garrahan_Mining_HQ.webp) |

### North Mire[edit]

| Location | Type | Description | Image | 
| Thunder Mountain Power Plant | T‑series | Enter the door labeled "Loading Dock" on the southeast side of the main building, go to the left. Armor is at one of the two Power Armor Stations. Another single piece of power armor can spawn on a table in one of the tents in the south part of the power plant yard. | ![PowerArmor Thunder Mountain Power Plant.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/c/cc/PowerArmor_Thunder_Mountain_Power_Plant.webp/170px-PowerArmor_Thunder_Mountain_Power_Plant.webp) |

The armor is just a bit farther down the hill, about 16 steps from the stump. | ![FO76 Location Dolly Sods Wilderness 08.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/c/cf/FO76_Location_Dolly_Sods_Wilderness_08.webp/170px-FO76_Location_Dolly_Sods_Wilderness_08.webp) |

| Dyer Chemical Sewers | T‑series | Entrance to the sewers requires a key card found in the side quest Tracking Unknowns. There are three entrances to the sewers. Any of them can be used but the most convenient is in the building in the southeast corner of the complex. | ![FO76 Location Dyer Chemical Sewers 03.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/c/cd/FO76_Location_Dyer_Chemical_Sewers_03.webp/170px-FO76_Location_Dyer_Chemical_Sewers_03.webp) |
